kpi.clientNoKpi: Customers have no KPI in this workspace.
kpi.title: Performance (KPI)
kpi.hint: Facts from time tracking, tasks, the AI agent's issue work, AI usage, GitHub and manager reviews. Copy the AI prompt to have an assistant write the report.
kpi.promptCopied: The prompt and the KPI dossier are on your clipboard.
kpi.noTime: No time tracked in this period.
kpi.noGitHubBody: No GitHub account is mapped to this person, so their commits and pull requests can't be counted. They can connect it on their profile, or a manager can map it.
kpi.noCommits: No commits or pull requests in this period.
kpi.noAI: No AI usage recorded in this period.
kpi.agentLine: Agent: {started} plans posted · {reviewed} handed to review · {mentions} mentions answered · {mcp} MCP actions
kpi.reviewHint: Your review appears in this person's KPI and in the AI dossier. They can read it.
kpi.deleteReviewBody: It disappears from the KPI and the dossier. This cannot be undone.
kpi.mapHint: For people who won't connect GitHub themselves: their GitHub username, and the e-mail addresses their commits use.
kpi.connectHint: Connect your GitHub account so your commits, pull requests and deployments on the workspace's linked repositories count in your KPI, including those from before you connect.
kpi.oauthOff: GitHub sign-in isn't configured on this server. Ask a manager to map your GitHub username instead.
kpi.teamHint: One row per employee for the period. Open a row for the full dashboard and the AI prompt.
kpi.teamNoPermission: Only project managers and admins can see the team KPI.
